title: Filipino bartender Roniel Lopez wins 2026 World Bartending Championship
summary: Filipino bartender Roniel Lopez of TGI Fridays Philippines won the 2026 World Bartending Championship in Orlando, Florida, beating seven competitors from around the world, the restaurant announced…

blocks.text: Filipino bartender Roniel Lopez of TGI Fridays Philippines won the 2026 World Bartending Championship in Orlando, Florida, beating seven competitors from around the world, the restaurant announced Friday.
